title: Quantum Recurrent Architectures for Financial Time Series Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2611.15298v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This study evaluates quantum classical hybrid recurrent architectures for financial time-series forecasting: a Quantum Long Short-Term Memory (QLSTM) network and Quantum Reservoir Computing (QRC) with lag-based inputs. Classical lag vectors are encoded into quantum states via amplitude encoding, which compactly represents normalized observations but requires nontrivial state preparation; the QLSTM gates and the QRC reservoir are implemented with parameterized quantum circuits, while classical optimizers train the interface and readout layers. On a monthly revenue series extended to 1056 months by a Gaussian-process--hidden-Markov generator, with a fixed chronological 70/15/15 split and one-step-ahead forecasts, we compare both models against a full-size LSTM, a classical control matched in parameter budget and interface architecture, a small plain LSTM, and classical reservoir computing, over ten seeds and against persistence, seasonal

translated_title: 面向金融时间序列预测的量子循环架构
translated_abstract: 本研究评估了用于金融时间序列预测的量子-经典混合循环架构：量子长短期记忆网络（QLSTM）以及采用基于滞后项输入的量子储层计算（QRC）。经典滞后向量通过振幅编码被编码到量子态中，该编码方式能够紧凑地表示归一化观测值，但需要非平凡的状态制备；QLSTM的门结构与QRC的储层均由参数化量子电路实现，而接口层与读出层则由经典优化器训练。实验在一个由高斯过程-隐马尔可夫生成器扩展至1056个月的月度收入序列上进行，采用固定的按时间顺序70/15/15划分及单步前瞻预测，在十个随机种子下，将两种量子模型与完整规模的LSTM、参数预算与接口架构相匹配的经典对照模型、小型朴素LSTM以及经典储层计算进行比较，并与持久性预测、季节性基准（原文此处截断）……
tldr: 本文提出并系统评估了两种量子-经典混合循环架构（QLSTM与基于滞后输入的量子储层计算）用于金融时间序列预测，在扩展的月度收入数据集上与多种经典基线模型进行了对比实验。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes and systematically evaluates two quantum-classical hybrid recurrent architectures—QLSTM and Quantum Reservoir Computing with lag-based inputs—for financial time-series forecasting, benchmarking them against classical LSTM and reservoir computing baselines on an extended monthly revenue dataset.
